stops.detail: Salzburger Lungau and the adjacent Carinthian Nockberge were awarded as a Biosphere Park by UNESCO in July [dated source]. It covers the entire Salzburg district of Tamsweg (Lungau) and adjacent areas of the Nockberge in Carinthia. This makes the area bordering the federal states of Salzburg and Carinthia a “model region for sustainable development”.
